S01-001: Only the light above the workstation is on in the imaging room. Serika sits before the viewing monitor, checking a report line by line.
S01-002: She checks the last line and presses Save before noticing Sakaguchi standing by the door.
S01-003: “Sakaguchi-kun. Give me a moment. I'm almost done.”
S01-004: “No rush. I was just passing by and wondered whether you'd finished.”
S01-005: “You don't often hear ‘no rush’ in the imaging room.”
S01-006: Serika sends off the report, takes off her glasses, and sets them at the corner of the desk. An opened document envelope lies beside them.
S01-007: “Did you have something else to do today?”
S01-008: “I went to see the police this morning.”
S01-010: “Yes. I told them everything I knew. There is still a lot to verify, so I may have to go again.”
S01-011: “If they need me to testify in court, I'll go.”
S01-012: She smooths the edge of the envelope, as though organizing a complicated imaging report.
S01-014: “It was actually calmer than I'd expected. Whatever they asked, I tried to answer as accurately as I could.”
S01-015: “Only after saying some things aloud did I realize how many times I'd already repeated them in my head.”
S01-017: “Nanami is still recovering slowly. She messaged me today, too. She said several of the others had safely left the old hospital.”
S01-018: “Aya, Yayoi, Eri… Where they want to work next should be for them to decide.”
S01-019: “I'd be happy if they wanted to come to Hoshimi. But I don't want ‘for their own good’ to turn into making their decisions for them again.”
S01-020: She puts the envelope away, and her phone screen lights up. Serika glances at the call history but takes a long time to lock the screen.
S01-022: “…Yes. He called once this morning, but I didn't answer. Today, I want to call him back myself.”
S01-023: “But right now, I don't quite want to walk over there alone.”
S01-024A-1: “I'll walk with you to the courtyard. When you want to talk alone, I'll step away.”
S01-024A-2: “…All right. You always know when to stand a little closer.”
S01-024B-1: “I'll wait nearby. There's no rush to talk.”
S01-024B-2: “I haven't even said anything yet… and you've already left me a way out.”
S01-025: Serika changes out of her white coat, picks up her handbag, and leaves the imaging room with Sakaguchi.
S01-026: “After the call, I'm meeting Miyuki for coffee.”
S01-027: “Sounds like a busy day for you, then.”
S01-028: “…I planned it myself. Just thinking about that feels a little unbelievable.”
S02-001: In the courtyard at dusk, tree shadows cover half a bench. Serika stops beside it, holding her phone.
S02-002: She looks down at the number on the screen, her thumb hovering over the call button.
S02-003: “…A moment ago, I thought I was ready.”
S02-004: “Sakaguchi-kun, would you wait over there for a moment?”
S02-005: “Of course. I'll be by the covered walkway.”
S02-006: After Sakaguchi walks away, Serika sits down and finds her father's number again. She takes a deep breath and calls.
S02-008: “It's me. I saw your call this morning.”
S02-009: “You finally called. I thought… Never mind. How have you been feeling lately?”
S02-010: “I'm well. I'm still working at Hoshimi. I spent today reading scans as usual.”
S02-011: “I heard you went to help with the investigation.”
S02-012: “Yes. I'll keep going. I don't intend to hide what I know anymore.”
S02-013: “…I've been thinking back over what happened at the hospital, too.”
S02-014: “Back then, I was so focused on whether the hospital was running properly that I never really asked how you were getting through each day.”
S02-015: “Father. I didn't call today to place all the blame on you.”
S02-016: “There's something… I have to tell you myself.”
S02-017: Her other hand slowly clenches the fabric of her skirt. She holds the phone to her ear, but for a while, no sound comes.
S02-018: “Shiozaki tried to force me to hurt you. He even… wanted me to poison your medicine.”
S02-020: “I didn't do it. In the end, Miyuki got me out of there.”
S02-021: “But for a time, I came so close that I couldn't even be certain I wouldn't do what he told me.”
S02-022: “I didn't want someone else's statement to be the first place you heard about this.”
S02-024: There is a long silence on the other end. Serika does not hurry him; she simply waits with her eyes lowered.
S02-025: “I don't know what to say right now. I had no idea you'd been pushed that far.”
S02-026: “I didn't call to ask you to forgive me right away, either.”
S02-027: “I want to hear you out first. This time, at least let me listen properly.”
S02-029: “I'll deal with the hospital myself, too. You don't have to tell me on the phone today whether you'll come back to take over.”
S02-030: “I haven't decided yet. For now, I want to stay at Hoshimi.”
S02-031: “All right. Then make a good life for yourself there for now.”
S02-032: “When you have time, come home for a meal. Just a meal at home, not a meeting.”
S02-033: Serika lifts her head. The sunlight has already moved off the other end of the bench.
S02-034: “…All right. I'll call you when I can find the time.”
S02-036: “…And thank you for being willing to call.”
S02-037: The call ends. Serika rests the phone on her lap and sits quietly for a while before wiping a little moisture from the corner of her eye with a finger.
S02-038: Sakaguchi returns from the covered walkway and stops a step away from her.
S02-040: “Yes. …We were finally able to really talk.”
S02-041: “But I think there's one more person I need to talk things through with today.”
S02-043: “Yes. I want to see her on my own tonight. I'll come find you afterward.”
S02-045: Serika stands and gives Sakaguchi a small nod. After a few steps, her stride is much steadier than when she arrived.
S03-001: Miyuki Asakura is already seated by the café window. Two drinks sit on the table, and she is studying a small plate of sweets.
S03-003: “Not at all. I made a point of coming early today. Don't I deserve some praise?”
S03-004: “You actually got here before me today?”
S03-005: “That's why I said I deserve praise. Sit down. I haven't touched the dessert yet.”
S03-006: Serika sits across from her and takes the menu she offers. A glance at the drinks on the table brings a hint of surprise to her face.
S03-008: “Of course. We worked together for so long. I'm not about to forget a little thing like that.”
S03-009: They pick up their cups. Asakura tries a bite of dessert first, while Serika merely runs a fingertip around the rim of her cup.
S03-010: “Did you go to see the police today?”
S03-011: “Yes. I've told them everything I could.”
S03-012: “That must have been hard. If it's my turn later, I'll go, too.”
S03-013: “Nanami told me Aya and the others have all left the old hospital.”
S03-014: “I heard, too. Let them get some proper rest first. They don't need to decide about work right now.”
S03-015: “I used to think that if I could just bring everyone back, we could start all over again.”
S03-016: “The people you bring back might not want to start over, you know.”
S03-017: “…Yes. So I thought I'd ask each of them what they wanted first.”
S03-018: Asakura nods and puts down her fork. Serika sets her cup back on its saucer and looks directly at her.
S03-019: “Miyuki. I called my father today, too.”
S03-020: “Really? Haven't you been too afraid to call him?”
S03-021: “I was still very afraid. But this time… we actually talked like a father and daughter for a while.”
S03-023: “And I finally felt that I could talk to you properly about the past.”
S03-024: Asakura's smile slowly fades. She puts down the fork in her hand and sits up straight.
S03-025: “When we were at that hospital, you pressured me on Shiozaki's orders, too.”
S03-026: “You knew I was afraid. For a while, whenever I saw you coming toward me, I'd wonder whether something else was about to happen.”
S03-029: “Yes. You had every reason to hate me.”
S03-030: “I was afraid back then, too. I wanted to protect myself. But that doesn't make what I did disappear. I'm sorry, Serika.”
S03-031: Serika does not answer at once. She looks at the pedestrians passing outside the window, then turns back after a while.
S03-032: “But in the end, you were also the one who took me away.”
S03-033: “I still remember that day. You called out to me, took my hand, and told me I didn't have to listen to him anymore.”
S03-034: “At the time, I just… couldn't bear to watch him drag you down any further.”
S03-035: “I know. So I've also kept feeling that I owed you for the rest of my life.”
S03-036: “Serika, you don't have to pretend the things I did never happened just because you're grateful to me.”
S03-037: “And I didn't take you away so you'd owe me a favor.”
S03-038: “…It took me a long time to understand that both things could be true.”
S03-039: “You hurt me, and I really am grateful to you.”
S03-042: “That's right. Here we are, safe and sound, drinking coffee together.”
S03-043: “…I'm just happy we can sit together like this.”
S03-044: Asakura reaches out and gently lays her hand over Serika's on the table. Serika does not pull away.
S03-045: “Miyuki. If one day I really decide to return to the old hospital… would you come with me and be the head nurse?”
S03-046: “Oh my, are you already poaching Hoshimi's staff?”
S03-047: “I'm only asking. You've always understood how to care for a whole team better than I do.”
S03-048: “Hold on. You haven't decided yourself yet. There's no need to arrange my job for me.”
S03-049: “I have it so easy at Hoshimi right now. The pay is decent, my colleagues are interesting, and no one's insisting I become someone important.”
S03-050: “…You're right. I shouldn't make your decision for you just because I'd miss you.”
S03-051: “When you've really made up your mind, come and ask me properly. I'll give it serious thought, too.”
S03-052: “All right. I'll wait for your answer.”
S03-053: “And I haven't agreed to be head nurse, you know. If you really want me back, you'd better offer a higher salary.”
S03-054: “…I'll make a note of your price.”
S03-055: “Right now? You really haven't changed a bit.”
S03-056: Serika finally smiles. She picks up her coffee, which has cooled a little, and slowly finishes it with Asakura.
S03-057: When they leave the café, they walk side by side to the intersection. Asakura waves and heads toward the hospital, while Serika takes another street to her own rendezvous.
S04-001: Night has fallen. Standing beside a streetlamp outside the hospital, Sakaguchi sees Serika come around the corner.
S04-003: “…I had coffee with Miyuki and said a lot of things I'd never dared to say before.”
S04-005: “A little. But it's easier than keeping all those words hidden.”
S04-006: She slips her arm through Sakaguchi's. They walk slowly along the pavement, passing a row of small shops with their shutters already down.
S04-007: “My father asked me to come home for a meal when I have time.”
S04-010: “He specifically said he wasn't asking me back for a meeting. …I nearly laughed on the phone.”
S04-011: “Then he knows what you're worried about.”
S04-012: “Perhaps he didn't before. Today, at least, he was willing to hear me out.”
S04-013: Serika holds his arm a little tighter but keeps walking.
S04-014: “It was the same with Miyuki. We finally talked about how we hurt each other at the old hospital.”
S04-015: “I used to think that because she'd saved me, I shouldn't resent her anymore.”
S04-016: “She said I could remember both things. …I think she's right.”
S04-017: “So where does that leave you two?”
S04-018: “Still friends. Perhaps better able to be friends than before.”
S04-019: “I even asked whether she'd come back with me someday as head nurse.”
S04-021: “No. First she quoted me a very high price.”
S04-023: “And she was right. I don't even know whether I want to go back. What gives me the right to plan someone else's future first?”
S04-024: “Sakaguchi-kun. Do you think I'm still too indecisive?”
S04-025A-1: “If you want to stay now, then stay without worrying. If you change your mind later, we can talk again.”
S04-025A-2: “…So I can be heard this sincerely even without rushing to make a promise.”
S04-025B-1: “I want to know what you want to do. I don't want to decide for you.”
S04-025B-2: “…From someone else, that might sound cold. From you, it makes me feel safe.”
S04-026: “For now, I want to stay at Hoshimi. Work in diagnostic imaging, and assist in surgery when I'm needed.”
S04-027: “Perhaps one day I'll want to go back and see whether the old hospital can really start over. Perhaps I won't.”
S04-028: “But at least I don't have to give anyone an answer tonight.”
S04-030: “And… if that day really comes, I'd like to hear what you think first.”
S04-031: “When you want to talk, I'll listen.”
S04-032: Serika stops, turns to face Sakaguchi, and looks up at him for a moment.
S04-035: “What is it? We're lovers, aren't we? May I not call you that?”
S04-036: “Of course you can. It's just the first time I've heard you say it, so I was a little surprised.”
S04-039: Serika freezes for a moment, then turns her face away. Under the streetlamp, the tips of her ears turn faintly red.
S04-041: They walk on a little farther. Serika suddenly lifts her head, as though recalling an important piece of work.
S04-042: “By the way. That thing you've been doing… where hospital staff volunteer to take part in surgical practice as patients.”
S04-043: “You mean the hospital's surgical practice program?”
S04-044: “Yes. I used to think it was absurd.”
S04-046: “I still think it's… a little absurd.”
S04-047: She lets out a small laugh at her own words, then looks seriously at Sakaguchi.
S04-048: “But if you'd like, I could take part in the future, too.”
S04-050: “I know. I used to stand on the other side of the operating table.”
S04-051: “I know what needs to be prepared and explained beforehand. But that doesn't mean I won't be afraid at all when I'm actually lying there.”
S04-052: “…I want to try trusting my own choice, and trusting you.”
S04-053A-1: “When the time comes, I'll follow the full patient process and carefully explain and confirm everything with you.”
S04-053A-2: “Good. Don't skip what needs explaining just because I understand it.”
S04-053B-1: “When you really want to arrange that day, we'll talk it through properly. There's no rush now.”
S04-053B-2: “…You're getting better at knowing whose decision it should be.”
S04-054: “But let me make this clear first. I'm volunteering. It's not to atone for anything, or to prove to anyone that I still deserve to be a doctor.”
S04-056: “What operation, when to have it, and how to prepare—we'll discuss those when I actually apply someday.”
S04-057: “And—if I'm a nervous wreck when the time comes, you're not allowed to laugh.”
S04-060: “I'll take you seriously, just as I would any other patient.”
S04-062: “But if I can barely get my words out then, don't tease me with ‘Doesn't Dr. Misono know all about this?’”
S04-066: Serika looks at Sakaguchi, and the trace of feigned sternness finally leaves her face. She leans gently against his shoulder.
S04-067: “It's strange. I used to think that shouldering everything myself was the only right thing to do.”
S04-068: “Now, just walking beside you like this makes me feel… I can leave tomorrow's worries for tomorrow.”
S04-071: She lifts her hand and interlaces her fingers with Sakaguchi's. Neither is in a hurry as they continue along the lamplit street.
S04-072: “Walk with me a little longer tonight.”
